sws.measure: SWS involuntary ('Total') hunger: % of families who experienced hunger at least once in the past three months
sws.geography: SWS areas: NCR, Balance Luzon (contains CALABARZON), Visayas, Mindanao. No province or municipality is surveyed separately.
notes: Respondents were household heads until December 2024 and adults from April 2025; there is no bridging round.
The commissioned March 2025 (Stratbase) voter round is excluded.

outlook.status: No forecast horizon is established as reliable. The latest-reading outlook is the evaluated best method on 2021-2026; the LightGBM forecast is shown as a research output.
outlook.elevatedScoreNote: elevatedScore is the model's score for 'hunger above its previous-year average'. It is not a calibrated probability: its Brier score did not beat climatology (R4).

evaluation.model: FIL-OA: one LightGBM regressor, pooled over 4 SWS areas and Leads 0-4, all 12 indicator families; learns the change from the latest SWS reading
evaluation.target: SWS involuntary hunger by area (continuous, percentage points) and ELEVATED = hunger above the area's average of the previous four quarters (researcher-defined, not an SWS/PSA class)

longHistorySecondary.flag: uses pre-2021 SWS; secondary, needs adviser approval

evaluation.evidenceStatus: Development evidence: every 2021-2026 quarter was examined in E107-E114; untouched confirmation needs the sealed forecasts to be scored from SWS 2026-Q4 onward.

cpi.definition: Food-price squeeze (FPD) = province food CPI YoY minus all-items CPI YoY (PSA, 2018=100); > 0 means food prices are rising faster than general prices. An economic-access indicator, not a hunger measure.
cpi.linkToHunger: No measurable link to SWS hunger (concurrent rho 0.14, p .59; leading Holm p = 1).
